# QCAE Online Questionnaire

Privacy-first static implementation of the Questionnaire of Cognitive and Affective Empathy.

## Discovery
- Human questionnaire: ./
- Agent/developer guide: ./agents.html
- Capability manifest: ./data/capabilities.v1.json
- Expanded agent guidance: ./llms-full.txt

## Machine-readable contracts
- Instrument: ./data/qcae.v1.json
- Compact instrument: ./data/qcae.v1.min.json
- References: ./data/references.v1.json
- Input schema: ./data/responses.schema.json
- Output schema: ./data/results.schema.json
- Programmatic API: ./src/qcae-api.js
- Local CLI: ./bin/qcae-score.mjs

## Invariants
- Responses are integers 1–4 in ascending agreement order.
- Original reverse-scored items: 1, 2, 17, 29.
- Portuguese validated variant excludes item 17.
- Raw scores are not diagnoses or normative classifications.
- Never put participant responses in URLs or transmit them without explicit informed consent.

## Rights
Code is AGPL-3.0-only. Questionnaire wording, translations, and participant data have separate rights. Read ./rights.html and ./data/references.v1.json before redistribution or model training.
